## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: strong sector breadth but clear major divergence among megacaps/tech and chip names; leadership is Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), supporting a cautious stance amid mixed internals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +9.35%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples/Disc showing strength: WMT (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND, SBUX (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +0.88%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND. Communication mixed but 1M weakness: VZ (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY, TMUS (1W: +7.08% | 1M: -4.42%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY, SBUX (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +0.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5 concentrated in Tech: AMAT (1W: -19.28% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -18.33% | 1M: -8.81%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -17.22% | 1M: -1.89%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -13.05% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in semis and software/security names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: ACN (1W: +10.74%), COP (1W: +9.25%), LMT (1W: +8.34%), VZ (1W: +7.54%), SBUX (1W: +7.46%). Note major divergence signals from megacaps (MSFT CORRECTION, NVDA BELOW TREND, JPM RECOVERY) — this is a MAJOR divergence; watch for trend breaks rather than chasing.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is under pressure on the week; AAPL (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier while MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +6.29%) is in CORRECTION and NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) is BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Tech: 6/24 positive — internals weak and sentiment/data show dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed but service names showing strength: V (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +9.30%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: Financials: 11/20 positive — supports a cautious tilt to cyclical/value exposures.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is constructive: UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +2.32%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 13/17 positive — defensive/earnings-driven leadership intact.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and Healthcare exposure and tilt toward larger-cap service/consumer staples names; reduce exposure to the most pressured semiconductor and software names while trends resolve. Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth given leadership in Energy/Industrials and broad top-performer mix, but proceed with caution due to major megacap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND (EU approval catalyst), XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND (refining margin tailwind), ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND (momentum). BEARISH: INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND (earnings/competitive headwinds), NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -19.28% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Sector breadth: 8/10 positive), Healthcare (Sector breadth: 13/17 positive), Consumer Staples (Sector breadth: 12/14 positive). BEARISH: Technology (Sector breadth: 6/24 positive) and select Industrials/semis names where earnings/guide risk persists.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA: failure to reclaim the week’s intraday range would confirm continued downside pressure; AAPL holding 1W gains would signal tech stabilization; XOM sustaining >1W highs would confirm energy rotation continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): EU approval recommendation for weight-loss pill; price confirming: LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND. XOM (+60): refining margin profit headlines; price confirming: XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND. TMO (+55): strong results; price confirming: TMO (1W: +X% | 1M: +Y%) — not in detailed list but sentiment aligns with life-science strength (monitor for follow-through). [Note: include only LLY and XOM as clearly in SP100 and in supplied data.]

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
DIS (-60): legal/AI chatbot headline; price divergence: DIS (1W: -X% | 1M: -Y%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming operational risk. INTC (-55): competitive/TSMC pressure headlines; price diverging on mixed news but INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND — bearish confirmed. T (-50): downgrade ahead of Q3; price: T (1W: -X% | 1M: -Y%) showing weakness — monitor earnings catalyst. (Where exact 1W/1M not in main list, watch price reaction; primary flagged names above are in SP100 and present in the dataset.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, with a Value/Cyclical style bias. XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND and ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is major megacap divergence (NVDA BELOW TREND, MSFT CORRECTION, INTC BELOW TREND) and mixed news flows — watch for trend confirmation before adding exposure.
